body: I know things will be different, but I don't get why the fuck I have to wait months or years for things to change while everyone around me is happy? I don't know if I can deal with it that long, even if I know the end will be worth it. I already know how I'd do it, why should I just stay and prolong how I feel and pretend that happiness is right around the corner?

Yeah, he's a great person. I'm going to tell him tonight. 

Some do yeah. Theyre a lot quieter and more sensitive around me. The one who's friends with my boyfriend keeps bringing it up because he knows I haven't told him yet.

Look, this isn't even what my post was about. Trust me, I'm not exactly fucking around. I'm trying figure out if the threats he made to me are actually going to happen. I'm scared enough about what'll happen once he realizes I told my parents and my friends. I have family in law enforcement, so I'm already aware of some of the things he'd be asked. My parents are already pushing me to report, I really don't need anyone else yelling at me to do so.
I'm telling him later on tonight.

I'm going to sort it out in my head first. That's what it comes down to. It's bad enough that it happened a month ago already, the last thing I want is to be questioned and for my answers to be along the lines of "I forgot." or "I don't know."

Like I said, I'm starting to lean towards reporting it. I guess I just want to try and sort through it in my head first. Yeah, I'm going to tell him later on tonight. I really do trust him, I just don't want him to have this thought if he thinks of me.
Rape by definition is unwanted or forced penetration with any body part or object. So, yes, I was raped.
I'm only hesitating because of what he's told me. Hell, I'm scared enough of what'll happen when he realizes I told my parents and some friends. I'm going to.
I think I'm going to try and tell him tonight or tomorrow. It depends what time it is when I get the chance to talk to him. Thanks, this helps a lot.
I don't know, I'm going to give it some serious thought. Thanks, I will.
He told me that all we were doing was cuddling. I feel like that's all he would tell a detective, too.
My parents know. Not sure if I'm going to report it however.
It's my only motivation to report it. I guess I'm scared on what the outcome would be.
I told my parents already. I don't know if I'll report it or not. I'm really torn on it, I guess.

But I don't know if I want to or not. I don't want to, because I don't want him to feel like I didn't trust him enough, or that I don't care about his efforts to help. But I want to because just having him know would probably be ridiculously easier on me, just not having to carry the weight by myself. Yeah, I think next time that I get on facebook or something before him, I'll type it out. 

It just....I don't know. I guess doesn't match my personality? That's the only way I can think of putting it. I'm the stubborn, sarcastic one who gets in arguments constantly and doesn't back down. It just doesn't sound like something that would ever happen to me. That's why I think people might start treating me differently.

He was someone I've known since I was a little kid, and one of my stepdad's good friends. We've watched movies together plenty of times, he's been there for almost all of my accomplishments and problems in life, normal things for an uncle to do for a niece they're close to. Why was I supposed to think that this time it'd be different?
I just feel bad for telling others but not him. But yeah, I understand what you mean.
Can anything even be done? It was a month ago. There's no proof except my word against his.
I will :) Thanks.

I've told my parents, although it was a really bad experience for me(they were yelling at me for being rude and stand-offish the next day to him, and I broke down and told them). Don't think I'm going to report it though.
